how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_017.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.light_attack_: Ignore weaker light damage or reduce the damage from more powerful attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.light_transfo: Channel your inner light to deal light damage and nauseate all nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lighten.descr: Lighten the caster's gravity for greater speed and jump power.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lightning_dom: Boosts Lightning abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lightning_lan: Launch a lighting projectile which will electrify your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lightning_man: Boosts Lightning abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.liquidize.des: Liquidize the earth where the caster desires to turn into deadly traps.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lust.descript: Assert your control over life and death. Drain your enemies of their strength or invigorate those under your wing.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_aura.de: Empower your attacks with many elemental aura.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_barrier: Coat the caster with a Magic Barrier with the strength based on Health.
Gather your aura into a powerful blast.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_earth_t: Gain access to the intermediate Earth Spirit Magic and boost your earth attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_flame_t: Gain access to the intermediate Flame Spirit Magic and boost your fire attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_jamming: Interferes with skills, magics, flight and transformation with mastery.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_light_t: Gain access to the intermediate Light Spirit Magic and boost your light attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_resista: Ignore weaker magical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger spells.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_sense.d: Using magicule to sense entities around.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_space_t: Gain access to the intermediate Space Spirit Magic and boost your spatial attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_wall.de: Generate a magic wall to protect the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_water_t: Gain access to the intermediate Water Spirit Magic and boost your water attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_wind_tr: Gain access to the intermediate Wind Spirit Magic and boost your wind attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magma_surge.d: Fire a spread of lava that burns and melts anything for a limited time.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.majesty.descr: By boosting your reputation with the villagers, gain a permanent Hero of the Village effect.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mana_manipula: Grant better control on Mana with less magicule cost on casted Magics and less damage taken from magicule-based attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.martial_maste: Empower your physical attacks, accelerate your thought process to react and dodge better while beating your enemies to submission.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mathematician: Use mathematics to improve your combat abilities, become able to use analytical appraisal to assess all.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.maximum_magic: Gather your aura into a gargantuan blast obliterating all who dare oppose you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.megiddo.descr: Unleash powerful sun blasts using water to kill any nearby foes. It can also be used manually to concentrate fire for any stronger foes.
